name: io.github.flow-84/n8n-guard
title: n8n-guard
description: Read-only health checks for self-hosted n8n: datastore growth, stuck runs, retention, git drift.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the n8n instance. Defaults to http://localhost:5678.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: n8n Public API key. Required for the execution and workflow checks.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_SQLITE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the n8n database.sqlite file. Required for datastore checks on SQLite.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_POSTGRES_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string. Takes precedence over N8N_SQLITE_PATH.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_GIT_REPO_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Checkout holding exported workflow JSON. Required for the git drift check.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_GUARD_STUCK_MINUTES
environmentVariables.description: Minutes a run may stay in `running` before it counts as stuck. Defaults to 15.

environmentVariables.name: N8N_GUARD_DB_WARN_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Datastore warning threshold in bytes. Defaults to 1073741824 (1 GB).

environmentVariables.name: N8N_GUARD_DB_CRITICAL_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Datastore critical threshold in bytes. Defaults to 4294967296 (4 GB).

environmentVariables.name: N8N_GUARD_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request API timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 15000.
